# Shopaccino
> Industry-focused ecommerce software for exporters, manufacturers, distributors, and D2C brands â€” built-in automation, integrated inventory, payments, logistics, and zero transaction fees on the platform.
Shopaccino is an industry-focused ecommerce software and solution designed by identifying real pain points across exporters, manufacturers, distributors, and D2C brands. It helps exporters sell globally, enables manufacturers and distributors to manage B2B and B2C sales from one system, and supports D2C brands with scalable growth through a branded website and mobile app. The platform enables end-to-end operational automation and on-the-go business management.
